note: Facets Custom Label adds one Facets build-stage processor (id facets_custom_label, stage build weight 50) with a single setting replacement_values: newline-separated 'origin|value|new label' lines where origin is r (raw value: machine name/entity id) or d (display value: title/term name). It rewrites only Result display values (Result::setDisplayValue). No config UI, permissions, Drush, or plugin types of its own; requires the Facets module. State lives in facets.facet.<id> -> processor_configs.facets_custom_label.settings.replacement_values. Medium/hard cases create namespaced fcl_* facet config entities (with a dummy facet_source_id, which Facet::save() accepts) and read/write that processor's mapping via drush.

evals.prompt: With the Drupal Facets Custom Label module, I want the facet item whose machine value is 'article' to display as 'Awesome news'. What exact line do I put in the processor's Replacement values box, and what do the r and d flags mean?
evals.expected_output: Add the line r|article|Awesome news. The format is origin|value|new label; r matches the item's raw value (machine name or entity id), d matches its display value (title or term name).

evals.prompt: Which Facets processor does the Facets Custom Label module provide (its plugin id), at which processing stage does it run, and what does it actually change on each facet result?
evals.expected_output: It provides the facets_custom_label build-stage processor (weight 50). At the build stage it replaces each matching result's display value (Result::setDisplayValue); raw values, the query, and counts are unchanged.

evals.prompt: There is no separate admin settings page for Facets Custom Label. How do you turn it on for a facet, and where in configuration is the label mapping stored?
evals.expected_output: Enable the Facets custom label processor on the individual facet (Processors section of the facet edit form). The mapping is stored in facets.facet.<id> under processor_configs.facets_custom_label.settings.replacement_values.

evals.prompt: On this site a facet with id fcl_known has the Facets Custom Label processor enabled. Inspect the live facet configuration and state what custom label the facet item with raw value 'article' will be shown as.
evals.expected_output: It will display as 'Awesome news': facets.facet.fcl_known has processor_configs.facets_custom_label.settings.replacement_values containing the line r|article|Awesome news.

evals.prompt: The facet fcl_map on this site uses Facets Custom Label to relabel an item by its display value. Inspect the live configuration: which display value is being remapped, and to what new label?
evals.expected_output: The display value 'Apple' is remapped to 'Apple products': facets.facet.fcl_map processor_configs.facets_custom_label.settings.replacement_values contains d|Apple|Apple products.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a facet with id fcl_task that does not yet use Facets Custom Label. Enable the facets_custom_label processor on it and add a mapping so the raw value 'page' is relabelled to 'Basic page' (line: r|page|Basic page). Apply the change to the live facet configuration.
evals.expected_output: facets.facet.fcl_task has processor_configs.facets_custom_label enabled with settings.replacement_values containing the line r|page|Basic page.

evals.prompt: The facet fcl_relabel on this site already has the Facets Custom Label processor enabled but its Replacement values are empty. Configure it so that a facet item currently displayed as 'Article' is shown as 'News' instead (match by display value), and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: facets.facet.fcl_relabel processor_configs.facets_custom_label.settings.replacement_values contains the line d|Article|News (origin d = display value).
